description: This file implements functions related to Git hooks, including locating hook scripts, verifying their existence, and executing them with specified options. It manages hook execution workflows and callbacks within the Git source code.

methods.name: const char * find_hook(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Locates the executable hook script for a given repository and hook name, checking for execution permission and handling extension stripping if enabled.

methods.name: int hook_exists(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether a specified hook script exists and is executable.

methods.name: int run_hooks_opt(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,struct run_hooks_opt * options)
methods.description: Executes a specified hook with given options, managing subprocess creation, environment, and callbacks.

methods.name: int run_hooks(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name)
methods.description: Runs a hook with default options.

methods.name: int run_hooks_l(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,...)
methods.description: Runs a hook with additional command-line arguments.
